python.source_or_package_manager: Install CPython 3.11 with your OS package manager, python.org, or conda-forge; the adapter does not bundle a Python interpreter.

python_packages.installation: Bootstrap a hash-verified pip wheel from PyPI, then pip install --require-hashes --only-binary :all:
